slug: 2025-07-03 Deputy Minister Njabulo Nzuza - Home Affairs Dept Budget Vote 2025-26, NCOP

facts.fact: The Deputy Minister of Home Affairs told the National Council of Provinces on 3 July 2025 that the department itself is rolling out Online Birth Registration at health facilities with maternity wards.

The Deputy Minister of Home Affairs said that in 2025/26 the department is rolling out Online Birth Registration at 25 health facilities with maternity wards and automating the birth registration process at 47 health facilities, birth registration already being rendered at 323 front offices and 391 health facilities.
The Deputy Minister of Home Affairs said the department's 2025/26 budget will allow the Online Birth Registration System to be rolled out in all 1,445 public health facilities with maternity wards.

note: The speech does not say how many offices or facilities register a birth digitally, so no offices fact is taken; it gives 323 front offices and 391 health facilities rendering birth registration, and 1,445 public health facilities with maternity wards as the total. Also stated: 868,476 births and 143,301 late registrations of birth registered in the previous year; mobile offices deployed to 10,149 service areas in 2024/25, collecting 247,231 Smart ID applications.
